parsed.rationale_overall: System A provides more concrete, actionable dollar amounts and clearer step-by-step execution guidance with well-grounded quantitative claims (valuations, expense ratios, correlations tied to portfolio specifics), while System B offers slightly stronger goal-linked personalization via the education glide-path but includes weaker numeric grounding and a somewhat inconsistent allocation_pct field.
